title: TOPTICA Photonics
summary: German maker of diode lasers and frequency combs for quantum and scientific applications.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

TOPTICA builds tunable diode lasers, frequency combs and terahertz systems used in quantum computing, atomic clocks and spectroscopy. Trapped-ion and neutral-atom quantum computers rely on precise laser systems for cooling and manipulation. The company sells to research labs and quantum-hardware developers.

Technology Exposure

  • Tunable diode lasers
  • Optical frequency combs
  • Terahertz and spectroscopy systems

What To Watch

  • Quantum-computing laser demand
  • Research funding
  • Competition from photonics majors

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
